scope: Homepage grouping is editorial. Shared capabilities are extracted only from exact dependsOn and pack triples in selected source snapshots. No proposed dependencies are inserted.
missing: A source with no selected machine declaration has no inferred capability edges.
mechanism: Existing source.rel parser, programme kernel, html.serialize, css projection, source.lex and sp.present; unchanged native closure and budget.
snapshotBoundary: Not live synchronization. Original file hashes, source-root names, original line numbers and exact excerpt text are recorded. CI checks the snapshots and line bindings; original local sources are checked when available.
